# License-text sources

The license texts in this directory were retrieved from the Qt project's own
SPDX license directory:

https://github.com/qt/qtbase/tree/dev/LICENSES

They are fallback copies when installed PySide/Shiboken wheel metadata does not
carry license files. Installed license files take precedence when available.
The names preserve the SPDX identifiers. The exact dependency versions bundled
by a native build are recorded in its BUILD-INFO.json; dependency source links
are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

`Python-LICENSE.txt` is the CPython 3.12 license and notices from
https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/3.12/LICENSE, matching the native build's
Python minor version. Apache-2.0.txt also covers the OpenSSL 3.x license terms.
